text: APPROVE: The extracted helpers keep the same filtering, trimming and `continue`/`return` semantics, and moving the indent check, `PODS` handling and `DEPENDENCIES` handling out of the loop should bring the method well under 15. I could not build it or see the declarations of `direct` and `resolved`, so I'm assuming they are `List<string>` and `Dictionary<string, string>` to match the new helper signatures.
